contexts.text: To quarrel () = to deny it to be such, by saying that they do not see it. AC 3427, AC 3428, AC 3432.
When men shall quarrel () = grievous contention among truths.
Inside the houses in the milder Hells there are continual quarrels... AR 421:end.
Why are you quarreling about goats wool?
Solifidians are under the nates, in quarrels and railings among themselves. (See AR 421:end.)
On a Hell where they quarrel about things religious.
Those who are continually quarreling about doctrinal things, induce a pain on the great toe of the left foot.
Therefore (those who separate and exclude good from truth) quarrel about the truths of faith. Signified.
There are Hells where they do nothing else than quarrel about truths. Described.
